web_sources_checked.name: Isaac Sim container installation
web_sources_checked.finding: Official Isaac Sim container installation is recommended for remote headless/cloud Docker deployment and requires Docker plus NVIDIA Container Toolkit.

web_sources_checked.name: NVIDIA NGC Isaac Sim container
web_sources_checked.finding: Official Isaac Sim containers are distributed through NVIDIA NGC with EULA/privacy environment requirements.

web_sources_checked.name: Isaac Lab Docker Guide
web_sources_checked.finding: Isaac Lab has docker/container.py workflows and current pre-built NGC Isaac Lab containers such as nvcr.io/nvidia/isaac-lab:2.3.2, but release-specific availability is limited.

web_sources_checked.name: Isaac Lab Container Deployment
web_sources_checked.finding: Isaac Lab containers can be built on NVIDIA Isaac Sim images, and HPC workflows include Docker-to-Singularity/Apptainer conversion guidance.

web_sources_checked.name: TacEx Docker container setup
web_sources_checked.finding: TacEx requires an Isaac Lab Docker image with Isaac Sim 4.5 / Isaac Lab 2.1.1 and then builds an isaac-lab-tacex project image.
